description: Open Source licenses accepted only when listed requirements are satisfied and documented
policy: Approve only after the agent/developer confirms and documents the requirement. Do not silently treat as unrestricted Accepted.

conditional.requirement: If distributed, source code obligation must be checked.
If distributed, source code obligation must be checked.
If distributed, source code obligation must be checked.
Use by linking only. If modified or distributed, requirement must be checked.
Source code obligation applies to EPL files only.
Modified MPL files must follow MPL license requirement.
Modified CDDL files must follow CDDL license requirement.
License limitation must be checked before use.
Must include license notice and attribution. Prefer an explicit Apache SPDX id (e.g. Apache-2.0).
Must include license notice and attribution. Prefer an explicit BSD SPDX id (e.g. BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause).
Other Accepted Phase 2 licenses: follow license condition, attribution, and notice requirement. Document the exact license and compliance steps before use.

compoundRules.rule: If any token in a compound expression is Accepted-with-Requirement, the whole dependency is Approved-with-Requirement and all matching requirements must be documented.
